scripts.eval:create-task:all: for s in evals/create-task/scenarios/*/; do node evals/shared/runner.mjs "$s" || exit 1; done
scripts.eval:create-story:all: for s in evals/create-story/scenarios/*/; do node evals/shared/runner.mjs "$s" || exit 1; done
scripts.eval:develop-task: node --test 'evals/develop-task/protocol/*.test.mjs' && for s in evals/develop-task/step-isolation/*/; do node evals/shared/runner.mjs "$s" || exit 1; done
scripts.eval:develop-story: node --test 'evals/develop-story/protocol/*.test.mjs' && for s in evals/develop-story/step-isolation/*/; do node evals/shared/runner.mjs "$s" || exit 1; done
scripts.eval:all: for s in evals/create-task/scenarios/*/ evals/create-story/scenarios/*/ evals/develop-task/step-isolation/*/ evals/develop-story/step-isolation/*/; do node evals/shared/runner.mjs "$s" || exit 1; done
scripts.validate:all:
printf '\033[1mValidating skills…\033[0m

'; pass=0; fail=0; for d in skills/*/; do if [ -f "${d}SKILL.md" ]; then if python3 skills/create-skill/scripts/quick_validate.py "$d"; then pass=$((pass+1)); else fail=$((fail+1)); fi; fi; done; echo ''; if [ $fail -eq 0 ]; then printf "  \033[32m●\033[0m \033[1m%d\033[0m passed  \033[2m0 failed\033[0m
" $pass; else printf "  \033[32m●\033[0m \033[1m%d\033[0m passed  \033[31m●\033[0m \033[1m%d\033[0m failed
" $pass $fail; fi; echo ''; [ $fail -eq 0 ]
scripts.package: cd skills/create-skill/scripts && for d in ../../*/; do name=$(basename "${d%/}"); [ -f "${d}SKILL.md" ] && python3 package_skill.py "$d" "$d"; done
